title: Toward Human-Centered Human–AI Interaction: Advances in Theoretical Frameworks and Practice
reasoning: The paper integrates ethical frameworks as a core pillar of Human-Centered AI (HCAI). It discusses 'Ethics Alignment Design' as a fundamental element of the HCAI framework, focusing on ensuring AI solutions avoid discrimination and uphold fairness and justice. Ethical considerations are not just a boilerplate section but are systematically built into the reviewed models and methodology.
